investigation_actions: Review the originating security alert and validate the detection context
Review source and destination activity around the detection timestamp
containment_actions: Validate that automated containment remains effective
Confirm that no additional suspicious activity is observed after containment
evidence_collection_actions: Preserve the original alert and enrichment results
Preserve triage, case-management, notification, SLA, and risk-scoring artifacts
Record analyst findings and response actions in the incident case
closure_guidance: Consider closure only after analyst validation confirms no additional suspicious activity
analyst_summary: STANDARD analyst review recommended. Continue investigation and validate containment before considering case closure.
